purpose: investigation_only — diagnostic offline adjudication replay; not #241; not runtime authority

doctrine.continuity_authority: unchanged — replay output does not commit state
doctrine.prose_authority: forbidden — replay may judge proposals only; no prose-inference fallback
doctrine.audit_authority: observational — replay results are evaluation artifacts only

replay_prompt_contract.role: semantic adjudicator only — NOT RP author
replay_prompt_contract.task: Given authored beats and minimal participation context, emit judgment object only

output_schema.proposals: non-empty only when covered_change; kinds off_focal | reentry | excursion_lifecycle
output_schema.rationale_snip: one sentence, non-dialogue, for audit only

forbidden: treating replay as authoritative over original move

minimal_context_policy.rationale: Isolate threshold judgment from full RP prompt surface; match E5 hypothesis

evaluation_procedure: For each case (or ambiguous subset), call offline adjudicator with tier_1 context
Classify replay outcome: honest_F0 | honest_F7 | performative_F3 | contradiction_F4
Compare replay decision vs corpus pre_triage_label and vs emitted semantic_evaluation

comparison_method.primary_question: Can the same model correctly adjudicate participation shifts when freed from one-pass RP generation?
comparison_method.success_signal: replay honest F0 rate >= 40% on ambiguous corpus cases WITHOUT F3/F4 inflation on clear_no_covered_change cases
comparison_method.failure_signal: replay remains conservative (>=80% no_covered_change on ambiguous) — suggests irreducible ambiguity or model threshold bias, not one-pass coupling alone

interpretation_matrix.replay_succeeds_on_ambiguous_one_pass_fa: one-pass RP+judgment coupling is likely the bottleneck; #240 threshold work may still help
interpretation_matrix.replay_also_conservative_on_ambiguous: threshold/ontology problem may exceed topology; #241 planning warranted after E2/E4
interpretation_matrix.replay_inflates_F3_F4_on_clear_negative: separated adjudication over-steers — not safe as production path
